name: Tax Calculation Information 6
definition: Information used to calculate the tax.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Basis used to determine the capital gain or loss, eg, the purchase price.

ExtendedBasis.name: Extended Basis
ExtendedBasis.definition: Basis used to determine the capital gain or loss, eg, the purchase price.

TaxableAmount.name: Taxable Amount
TaxableAmount.definition: Amount of money that it is to be taxed.

BasisOrExtendedBasisRule.definition: Either Basis or ExtendedBasis may be present, but not both.
